entities.name: C3PL31 adenylate kinase
observations: Exact 181-aa query sequence matches reviewed UniProt C3PL31 from Corynebacterium aurimucosum (100% identity and coverage).
Catalyzes reversible terminal-phosphate transfer between ATP and AMP; annotated as monomeric and cytoplasmic.
UniProt annotations place it in purine metabolism and AMP salvage, contributing to adenine nucleotide and cellular energy homeostasis.

entities.name: AMP salvage
observations: Reviewed UniProt C3PL31 annotation lists AMP salvage (AMP biosynthesis via salvage; AMP from ADP) as a biological process.

entities.name: Cytoplasm
observations: Reviewed UniProt C3PL31 annotation reports cytoplasmic localization.
